Festival Essentials

Where and when does Graspop Metal Meeting take place?

Graspop Metal Meeting 2027 takes place from 17 through 20 June in Festival Park Stenehei, Dessel (Belgium). 

When do tickets for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027 go on sale?

Tickets for GMM 2027 will go on sale at 10 a.m. on Saturday 14 November through Ticketmaster. Mastercard holders can get their hands on presale tickets between 10 a.m. on Thursday 12 November and 9 a.m. on Saturday 14 November [festival and VIP tickets only]. Go to priceless.com/music for full details.

Which bands are playing Graspop Metal Meeting 2027?

Check out our line-up page for all confirmed acts.

I’d like to work at Graspop Metal Meeting. Where can I apply?

Unfortunately GMM has no vacancies for individual volunteers. However, we have been working with a number of associations for many years. Your association can apply here. 

Would you like to run a merchandise stand in the Metal Market or the Festival Fair?

Submit your application to Orange Artist Promotion (Dido Smit): tel. 0031 (0)70 3856001 or via info@festivalfair.eu.

Would you like to have your food truck at the festival?

Please send an email to yannick@bevers.be to register.

Our final headliner for GMM 2027!

4 Nov

Tickets go on sale on Saturday 14 November.

I want out! With Helloween we’re adding the final headliner to the line-up of our 30th anniversary edition! The German power metal pioneers have a milestone of their own to celebrate as they will be bringing their special 40 Years Anniversary show to Dessel. On Thursday 17 June they are the final act on the North stage.

Just to recap, here are all the headliners for GMM2027:

Thursday 17 June: Parkway Drive / Helloween
Friday 18 June: Evanescence / Faith No More
Saturday 19 June: blink-182 / Marilyn Manson
Sunday 20 June: Mötley Crüe / Slash ft. Myles Kennedy and The Conspirators

Helloween emerged in the 80s as one of the founders of the European power metal scene. Albums like ‘Keeper of the Seven Keys Part I’ and ‘Keeper of the Seven Keys Part II’ are still considered landmark albums within the genre. Tracks like ‘I Want Out’, ‘Future World’ and ‘Eagle Fly Free’ are absolute classics and are still among the standout moments in any Helloween show.

In 2017 vocalist Michael Kiske and singer/guitarist Kai Hansen returned to the Helloween fold, joining Andi Deris to form a line-up featuring three frontmen. Since then, this line-up released two more albums with the eponymous ‘Helloween’ (2021) and ‘Giants & Monsters’ (2025). In late 2025 they embarked on a world tour in celebration of their 40th anniversary. Following a brief winter break, the festivities resumed in the spring and are set to continue into 2027. On Thursday 17 June their special 40 Years Anniversary show will take Graspop Metal Meeting by storm.

A new week, another headliner for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027!

2 Nov

Time to reveal our second headliner for Sunday 20 June.

World on Fire! We’re kicking off our third announcement week with a new headliner for our 30th anniversary edition. With Slash feat. Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators we are adding a 7th headliner to the GMM2027 line-up! The legendary Guns N’ Roses guitarist and his band are set to headline the North Stage on Sunday 20 June. The other headliners already announced for GMM2027 are Parkway Drive, Faith No More, Evanescence, blink-182, Marilyn Manson and Mötley Crüe.

Slash became world-famous as the guitarist for Guns N’ Roses. His typical sound is the backbone of hits like ‘Sweet Child O’ Mine’, ‘Welcome to the Jungle’ and ‘November Rain’. Slash has also built an impressive track record with projects like Slash’s Snakepit and Velvet Revolver. In recent years he’s been recording and performing alongside Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators, with whom he has released four albums to date. 

In 2024 Slash released a blues album with ‘Orgy of the Damned’, with contributions by Brian Johnson, Iggy Pop and Chris Stapleton. ‘Flying Blind’, his fifth album with Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators, is scheduled to drop in February of next year. His previous gigs in Dessel have always gone down a storm and next summer he’ll be back for more when he closes the North Stage on Sunday 20 June.

Headliner number 6 for GMM 2027!

30 Oct

The second headliner for Friday 18 June! 

Wake me up inside! We’re going to end the week on a high note with the announcement of another heavy hitter for our 30th edition: Evanescence! Ten years after their maiden show here, the band around frontwoman Amy Lee is returning to Graspop Metal Meeting. On Friday 18 June they will headline the South Stage alongside our North Stage headlines Faith No More.

Evanescence forced a worldwide breakthrough with ‘Fallen’, an album that blends heavy guitars, piano melodies and Amy Lee’s instantly recognisable voice. With hits like ‘Bring Me to Life’, ‘My Immortal’ and ‘Going Under’, the American band from Little Rock, Arkansas, rapidly established itself as a household name on the alternative rock and metal scene. On subsequent albums such as ‘The Open Door’ and ‘The Bitter Truth’, Evanescence continued to develop that mix of engaging melodies and powerful guitar work.

Ten years ago Evanescence first set foot on the Dessel plains and last September they rocked Forest National to the rafters with a stunning display of craftsmanship. Next year they are returning to Graspop Metal Meeting for their second performance, as part of our 30th anniversary edition. With ‘Sanctuary’, their sixth studio album released earlier this year, their set list will also include new material. Those who have seen them perform know that classics such as ‘Bring Me to Life’, ‘My Immortal’ and ‘Going Under’ are always among the highlights of the show. On Friday 18 June, Evanescence will close out proceedings on the South Stage.

The first headliner for Sunday 20 June!

28 Oct

Introducing the closing act of GMM 2027

Kickstart My Heart! Mötley Crüe are returning to Dessel! With the memory of their 2023 performance still fresh in our minds, the American glam metal giants will be headlining Graspop Metal Meeting for the third time. Mötley Crüe will close the 30th edition of Graspop Metal Meeting on Sunday 20 June. Previously, Parkway Drive (Thursday 17 June), Faith No More (Friday 18 June), blink-182 (Saturday 19 June) and Marilyn Manson (Saturday 19 June) were announced as co-headliners.

Mötley Crüe turned the 80s into a never ending rock-’n’-roll party. Emerging from the clubs on Sunset Boulevard, Nikki Sixx, Vince Neil, Mick Mars and Tommy Lee developed into one of the leading bands of the glam and hard rock scene. With ‘Too Fast for Love’, ‘Shout at the Devil’ and ‘Dr. Feelgood’ they sold millions of records worldwide and were instrumental in shaping the 80s glam rock scene.

Old habits die hard. In 2015 it looked like the Crüe had come to the end of the line until they announced their return to the live stage in 2019. The release of ‘The Dirt’ fuelled a resurgence that resulted in a full-blown comeback and a series of high-profile stadium shows. Mötley Crüe, with guitar virtuoso John 5 replacing Mick Mars, can still rock a festival arena to the core with a set chock-full of classics. Ready to round off our anniversary edition with hits like ‘Kickstart My Heart’, ‘Dr. Feelgood’ and ‘Shout at the Devil’?

A new headliner for Saturday 19 June!

26 Oct

Tickets on sale from 14 November.

Antichrist Superstar! A new week, a new announcement for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027. On Saturday 19 June, Marilyn Manson will rock the stage in Dessel at our 30th anniversary edition. The American shock rocker is joining blink-182 on Saturday and will top the bill on the North Stage. Previously Parkway Drive were announced for Thursday 17 June and Faith No more for Friday 18 June.

Since the bottom half of the 90s, Marilyn Manson has been one of the most recognisable names on the alternative metal scene. Albums like ‘Antichrist Superstar’, ‘Mechanical Animals’ and ‘Holy Wood’ established a signature sound that blends industrial, metal and rock. Standout tracks like ‘The Beautiful People’, ‘The Dope Show’, ‘Tourniquet’ and ‘mOBSCENE’ have become classics of the alternative metal scene.

After a number of turbulent years, Manson wrote a new chapter in 2024 with ‘One Assassination under God – Chapter 1’, followed by ‘One Assassination under God – Chapter 2’ earlier this year. The new album will feature in his first performance in Dessel since 2018, as he is scheduled to close out the North Stage on Saturday 19 June.

The first announcement for Friday 18 June!

23 Oct

Discover the third headliner for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027! 

Happy Birthday F*cker! With blink-182 and Parkway Drive, we’ve already announced two bombshells for our 30th edition and now we’re adding another heavyweight to next year’s line-up with Faith No More. Meanwhile it’s been 11 years since the band last graced the GMM stage. In 2022 they were unfortunately forced to cancel but now they’re back to headline the North Stage on Friday 18 June.

Faith No More were one of the bands that shaped the alternative metal scene. Never afraid to explore new horizons, the San Francisco-based band around figurehead Mike Patton developed an idiosyncratic blend of metal, funk, punk and rock. Albums such as ‘The Real Thing’, ‘Angel Dust’ and ‘King for a Day... Fool for a Lifetime’ were landmarks in alternative music, spawning classic tracks such as ‘Epic’, ‘Midlife Crisis’ and ‘A Small Victory’.

The live stage is probably the environment where this quirky single-mindedness really comes into its own. With Mike Patton at the helm, a Faith No More show can go in any direction and that’s exactly why their live performances are so unpredictable. Eleven years after their last performance here and four years after 2022’s cancellation, they’re finally returning to Dessel next summer to bring the North Stage to a thunderous close on Friday 18 June.

Discover our second headliner for the 30th edition of Graspop Metal Meeting!

21 Oct

The first band for Thursday 17 June! 

One life, one shot, give it all you got! On the heels of our announcement of blink-182 as headliner #1, we’re dropping headliner #2 for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027. Their 2023 headlining performance set the arena ablaze and now Australian metalcore giants Parkway Drive are back! On Thursday 17 June, Winston McCall, Jeff Ling & co will wrap up proceedings on the South Stage.

From the small clubs in Byron Bay to the world’s biggest festivals: in twenty-plus years of existence Parkway Drive have come a long way. Since their 2003 inception, they have transcended the metalcore scene and cemented their place in modern metal with albums such as ‘Killing with a Smile’, ‘Horizons’, ‘Deep Blue’ and ‘Ire’. ‘Carrion’, ‘Wild Eyes’ and ‘Vice Grip’ are just a few of the live staples that turn a festival arena into a churning mosh pit in the blink of an eye.

If you caught their jaw-dropping GMM performance in 2023 then you know that these guys pack a serious live punch. Their show was among the weekend’s standout performances and got the whole arena moving. Next year they’re coming back to Dessel to deliver another shot of boot-to-throat metalcore as they close out the South stage.

First headliner for the 30th edition of Graspop Metal Meeting announced!

19 Oct

Discover the first headliner for Saturday 19 June. 

What’s my age again? Next year GMM is blowing out 30 candles and we’re pleased to drop our first headliner announcement for this anniversary edition: blink-182! With their maiden GMM appearance on Saturday 19 June, the American punk rock band will close out the South Stage in style

Few bands have had a bigger impact on the modern punk rock scene than blink-182. Since their inception in California back in 1992, Mark Hoppus, Tom DeLonge and Travis Barker have earned a reputation as one of the genre’s leading lights. Their infectious guitar melodies, tongue-in-cheek approach and recognisable sound built a huge fan base and left an indelible mark on an entire generation of punk rock. Albums such as ‘Enema of the State’, ‘Take Off Your Pants and Jacket’, ‘blink-182’ and ‘ONE MORE TIME…’ are widely regarded as classics in the genre.

Tom Delonge left the band in 2015 but rejoined in 2022. Since then they’ve once again been touring in the original line-up. In 2023 they released their ninth studio album with ‘ONE MORE TIME...’. Ready to scream your lungs out at GMM2027 to ‘All the Small Things’, ‘What’s My Age Again?’, ‘First Date’ and all those other blink-182 hits?
